title: Secret Guard Report (I-159)
description: Shape of the list returned by coderain.validator.scan_hidden_forced(store) — one entry per gated-registry lore entry that is BOTH `hidden: true` and forced always-in (`pinned: true` or `weight: critical`). See docs/gabarit-autorat-secrets-i159.md for the authoring rule this report enforces. Deliberately excludes any field that could name the secret's content (title, body, aliases) — `registry` + `slug` only, so the report is safe to log at any verbosity.

registry.description: The gated registry file the entry lives in (MemoryStore.gated_registries()).

slug.description: The entry's stable slug — an identifier, not a spoiler by itself, but callers exposed to the player must still withhold it (see mcp_server._lore_warnings).

why.description: Which forcing flag(s) the entry carries alongside hidden:true. Never empty.
